name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
title: Navin Fluorine International Ltd-$ - 532504 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 80% to INR321 crore at 34.2% margin, driven mainly by capacity coming on stream and volumes; new capacity (R32, Chemours, Dahej debottleneck) is due in FY27 with 30% margin guided ±1-2%.

utilisation.quote: whatever we are doing on demand today, it is at an 80% capacity, as I've told you before.

capex.peers_comment: Analyst noted a competitor R32 capacity in excess of 120,000 metric tons in India by FY27; management said quota, not capacity, is the key question.
capex.quote: the key question is, is the quota available or not to anybody bringing in those capacities

triggers.label: R32 competitor capacity ~120,000 MT by FY27
triggers.quote: we are eyeing a capacity now in excess or 1,20,00 metric tons in India

triggers.label: Pass-through on RM inflation
triggers.quote: we are pretty confident of passing on the price increases to the finished product

triggers.label: CDMO FY27 $100m target reiterated
triggers.quote: we will push for hitting the number

triggers.label: Agchem visibility ~80% utilisation FY27
triggers.quote: we have visibility almost up to about 80% of our capacity utilization

triggers.label: Agchem prices flattish, volumes up
triggers.quote: it's going to look like flattish in terms of price rises

guidance.quote: we've always maintained that we will endeavor to do 30%. Given what we know today of the business circumstances, plus/minus 1% to 2%
the net working capital is expected to be in the range of 75 to 80 days versus our previous indicative guidance of 90 days of sales
As we look into coming into our FY27 number that we've always said of $100 million
I would model it in the range of between 7.5%, 8.5%, 9%, not more than that
we are talking of the 75% this year and then the balance next year
That would go to about 70%, 75% in the coming year.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Operating EBITDA more than doubled to INR1,082 crores with margins at 32.6%
Our net working capital days have improved to 74 days versus 90 days
this number that we've delivered this year of INR541 crores is again a solid sort of journey

red_flags.label: Nectar merchant volume slower; 50% uncontracted
red_flags.quote: We think it is slower than what we would have liked it to be.

red_flags.label: Competitor R32 capacity could cap pricing
red_flags.quote: there could be a situation where the competition was not earlier looking to add- the capacity

evasions.quote: a lot of this is a wash between currency and inflation

evasions.topic: R32 downside price case of INR400 crore
evasions.quote: It's a downside case that we always do more as a math rather than our belief.
I will leave you to your judgment. These are commercial things we deal with it
we don't commercially talk about these values
